content.text: Summary: Inspected T-6001 and the catalog namespace. The 4.8.0 release added a `log-forwarder` sidecar with no CPU request to the search-api pods; for Resource-type HPAs, a missing request on any container makes pod CPU utilization undefined, which matches the `<unknown>/60%` symptom. Resolved the ticket with two possible owner-applied fixes (add a cpu request to the sidecar, or move the HPA to a ContainerResource metric targeting the `api` container), each with doc citations.
